issue.title: Android Maestro E2E program
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Fluent Mobile has **no device E2E suite** today (`docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`). QA exercises journeys by hand on the **nightly Android APK** (`docs/guides/qa-process.md`).

This epic tracks an **Android-only Maestro** program: repeatable regression flows engineers run locally (and optionally via manual CI), plus a playbook mapping checklists → flows. Auth is native email/password (many `testID`s already) — no OAuth bypass.

## Condensed children (implementation order)

1. #489 — Foundation: harness, selectors, opt-in agent loop
2. #491 — Smokes: auth, navigation, record, sync/offline, edges
3. #495 — Multi-account isolation (checklist A–D)
4. #497 — Playbook + informational `workflow_dispatch` CI

## Process

- One child = one PR (default). Engineers sequence in order above.
- Maestro is the **repeatable Android regression** layer. Exploratory testing, hardware variance, and journeys without a green flow stay on nightly human QA.
- Maestro is **not** a required PR check in this epic.
- Needs QA? / `@Roslin22` handoff policy unchanged by this epic alone.

## Prerequisites

| Item | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| Dedicated Maestro accounts | ≥2 translators on `dev.api.fluent.bible` |
| Assignments | Each needs ≥1 project/chapter |
| Secrets (CI) | `MAESTRO_EMAIL` / `MAESTRO_PASSWORD` (+ second pair for #495) |
| Device | Android AVD or physical; no Expo Go |

## Scope / out of scope

**In:** Android harness, flows, docs, optional informational CI, selector gaps.

**Out:** iOS; auth bypass; Detox/Playwright; merge-blocking Maestro; E2E flags on store/production EAS; replacing nightly QA handoff.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Four children linked and on Project 4
- [ ] Journey map clear (automated vs residual manual) via #497
- [ ] Dedicated accounts + secret names documented
- [ ] CI stays optional until local suite is green

## Risks

- Shared **dev** DB — don’t destroy other translators’ data
- Empty My Work without assignments blocks #491/#495
- Mic + notification permissions for record/upload
- Expo Dev Menu on Debug+Metro steals taps

## Links

- `docs/guides/qa-process.md`, `qa-preview-testing.md`, `qa-multi-account-nightly.md` (#375)

comments.body:
FYI @Roslin22 — we filed an Android Maestro E2E program so device regression can be automated over time. No action needed from you right now; nightly Needs QA? handoff is unchanged.

**Tracker:** this epic

**Work slices (Backlog):**
1. #489 — Foundation (harness, selectors, opt-in agent loop)
2. #491 — Main smokes (auth, nav, record, sync/offline, edges)
3. #495 — Multi-account (your nightly checklist A–D)
4. #497 — Playbook mapping checklists → flows + optional manual CI

When #497 lands, `docs/guides/maestro.md` will say which journeys are automated vs still manual on the nightly. Until a flow is green for a path, keep testing that path as you do today.

## Async: what mobile E2E looks like (for building a suite)

FYI @Roslin22 — no reply needed. This is the process picture so your existing checklist style still works, with automation underneath for the boring/repeatable parts.

### Your current style stays the source of truth

A post like the #268 results is already a **test suite**:

1. Verified that …
2. Verified that …

Nothing about Maestro asks you to stop writing those lists. The change is **who/what executes each line**:

| Kind of line | Who runs it |
| --- | --- |
| Same path every nightly (login, open chapter, record a take, sync) | **Maestro** (automated on Android) |
| New feature nuance, visual polish, “does this feel right?”, one-off edge | **You on the nightly APK** (same as today) |
| Line that isn’t automated yet | **You** — and we can add a Maestro flow later if it becomes regression-critical |

So: you still author numbered expectations. Eng turns stable ones into Maestro flows. Your nightly pass/fail comment can say which lines were **Maestro** vs **manual**.

### Worked example (same mental model as #268)

Imagine a feature checklist:

1. Verified login with a translator account reaches Home.
2. Verified My Work opens an assigned chapter.
3. Verified Record can start/stop and play a take.
4. Verified Sync Now completes without error.
5. Verified the claim icon uses the expected primary color. ← **manual** (visual)
6. Verified no odd confirmation prompt on first claim. ← **manual** until we automate that flow

Today’s Maestro smoke tags map roughly to 1–4 (`auth` / `nav` / `record` / `sync`). Lines 5–6 stay on your numbered list until we encode them.

### How you grow “your” suite (without becoming an engineer)

1. **Write the numbered list** for the ticket (exactly like #268).
2. Mark each line: `Maestro` (if a flow already covers it), `Manual`, or `Candidate` (worth automating later).
3. Run / ask eng to run: `npm run maestro:test:smokes` (or a single tag like `maestro:test:record`) against the nightly-shaped Debug client — green = those lines pass without re-tapping the phone.
4. On the nightly APK, only walk the **Manual** / **Candidate** lines (and exploratory).
5. File bugs the same way you do now when a line fails.

You do **not** need to learn YAML to contribute. Eng owns the flow files; you own the checklist language and pass/fail judgment on what isn’t automated.

### Where things live

- Epic: #488
- Foundation + smokes (in PR): #489 / #491 → docs: `docs/guides/maestro.md`
- Multi-account checklist → future Maestro: #495 (same A–D steps you already use)
- Fuller QA playbook + optional CI button: #497

### What does **not** change

- Needs QA? → merge → you on the **nightly** APK
- Pass/fail still your call on the ticket
- Maestro is **not** a merge blocker; it’s repeatable Android regression so you spend phone time on judgment, not re-proving login every time

When #497’s playbook lands, it will include a table: journey → Maestro command → residual manual — written so a #268-style list plugs into it directly.

All four children shipped and closed:

1. #489 foundation → #500
2. #491 smokes → #501
3. #495 multi-account → #507
4. #497 playbook + informational CI → #509

Epic AC met: journey map + residuals in `docs/guides/maestro.md`; secrets documented; CI is `workflow_dispatch` only (not a merge gate). First post-merge harness dispatch failed at APK/emulator build ([run](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/actions/runs/34649217854)) — blocker noted on #497; cron stays off until stabilized.

Closing epic.
